name: Path Union Formulation
description: Instead of asking to connect a set of target nodes (which triggers Steiner tree / leaf-peeling algorithms), the problem defines the required edges as the union of the unique simple paths between all pairs of target nodes, asking for the minimum cost to retain them. This shifts the surface semantics from "network connectivity/spanning" to "path aggregation", encouraging naive all-pairs pathfinding which will TLE, while the underlying mathematical object remains the exact same minimal subtree.
